transcript.text: Thank you, Ravi and Jonah. Now let me raise the legal issue I flagged earlier. This week I discovered that an existing equipment lender's intercreditor agreement requires that lender's written consent before any maturity extension of our loan, and it also requires that the amended loan prohibit additional liens on the borrower's production equipment. My legal note on this has not yet been circulated to the group. This is critical because regardless of whether we approve a 6-month or 12-month extension, we cannot close this restructuring without first obtaining that equipment lender's written consent, and we'll need to include a no-additional-liens covenant on production equipment in the amended loan documents. I wanted to make sure everyone understood this constraint before we go further in discussing terms.
